Definition: a ring for the nose (or lips)
BiblicalUsage: Chach is a ring or a hook — the rings and bracelets the people brought willingly for the tabernacle, and the hook God promises to put in the nose of the raging king of Assyria to turn him back.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God puts a ring in the nose of the proud and a ring on the finger of the willing, and the difference is the heart.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
